abstract.t: This document outlines the critical factors for deploying Service Function Chaining (SFC) using Segment Routing over IPv6 (SRv6). It addresses deployment architectures, including both SRv6-aware and SRv6-unaware scenarios, and details the end-to-end provisioning lifecycle. Furthermore, it proposes reliability mechanisms and provides strategic recommendations for network operators transitioning from legacy NSH-based SFC to a modern, scalable SRv6 framework.
